slides.title: Title
bullets: Q3 2026 executive briefing
Desktop reliability, activation, and enterprise readiness

slides.title: Problem
bullets: 18% of new installs fail to complete first-run model setup within 24 hours.
P95 task startup is 4.8 seconds, versus the 2.0-second product target.
Owner Mei Chen reports 27% of support tickets involve daemon or desktop lifecycle confusion.
By 2026-09-30, enterprise pilots require auditable approvals across all 3 supported channels.

slides.title: Metric
bullets: Raise 7-day activation from 54% to 68% by 2026-09-30.
Reduce P95 task startup from 4.8 seconds to 2.5 seconds by Q3 close.
Reach 99.9% crash-free desktop sessions, owned by Ravi Shah.
Convert 6 of 10 enterprise pilots into paid annual contracts by 2026-10-15.

slides.title: Plan
bullets: Mei Chen will ship guided setup and diagnostics by 2026-08-14.
Ravi Shah will cut startup work by 40% through lazy initialization by 2026-08-28.
Elena García will deliver approval audit export for 3 channels by 2026-09-11.
Jon Bell will run 2 activation experiments per week from 2026-08-03 through 2026-09-25.

slides.title: Risks
bullets: Apple notarization may add 5 business days; owner Ravi Shah will pre-submit by 2026-09-04.
Provider API changes could affect 3 integrations; owner Elena García will complete contract tests by 2026-08-21.
A 20% support-capacity gap could slow pilot onboarding; owner Aisha Khan will add 1 contractor by 2026-08-17.
Enterprise security review may exceed 30 days; owner Jon Bell will open all 10 reviews by 2026-08-07.

slides.title: Ask
bullets: Approve $180,000 in Q3 engineering and support capacity by 2026-07-31.
Authorize Ravi Shah to hire 2 senior desktop engineers by 2026-08-10.
Assign CFO Dana Wu as executive sponsor for the top 5 enterprise pilots through 2026-10-15.
Approve a 15% pricing discount ceiling for 10 annual pilot conversions by 2026-09-30.
